# launchdarkly_environment_release_plan (Resource)

Provides a LaunchDarkly environment release plan resource.

~> **Beta:** This resource wraps a beta LaunchDarkly API (the `release-plans` endpoints, accessed with the `LD-API-Version: beta` header). Beta resources may change or be removed in future versions.

This resource lets you create and manage [release plans](https://launchdarkly.com/docs/home/releases) within a LaunchDarkly environment. A release plan defines how a flag release progresses through ordered phases and steps, which contexts each phase reaches, and which metrics are monitored along the way. Environment release plans replace release policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "launchdarkly_environment_release_plan" "checkout_rollout" {
  project_key     = launchdarkly_project.example.key
  environment_key = "production"
  key             = "checkout-rollout"
  name            = "Checkout rollout"
  description     = "Standard rollout for checkout changes"

  progressive_release = {
    randomization_unit = "user"
    advancement_mode   = "manual"
    cleanup_behavior   = "remove_rules_and_update_default_rule"

    phases = [
      {
        description = "Internal users"
        steps = [
          {
            allocation      = 10000
            duration_millis = 3600000
          },
        ]
        clauses = [
          {
            attribute    = "kind"
            op           = "in"
            values       = ["user"]
            context_kind = "user"
          },
          {
            attribute    = "email"
            op           = "endsWith"
            values       = ["@example.com"]
            context_kind = "user"
          },
        ]
      },
      {
        description = "Everyone"
        steps = [
          {
            allocation      = 25000
            duration_millis = 3600000
          },
          {
            allocation      = 50000
            duration_millis = 3600000
          },
          {
            allocation      = 100000
            duration_millis = 3600000
          },
        ]
        clauses = [
          {
            attribute    = "kind"
            op           = "in"
            values       = ["user"]
            context_kind = "user"
          },
        ]
      },
    ]

    metrics = {
      (launchdarkly_metric.completed_purchase.key) = {
        is_group      = false
        auto_rollback = true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `environment_key` (String) The key of the environment the release plan belongs to. A change in this field forces the destruction of the existing resource and the creation of a new one.
- `key` (String) The unique human-readable key that references the release plan. A change in this field forces the destruction of the existing resource and the creation of a new one.
- `name` (String) The human-friendly name for the release plan.
- `progressive_release` (Attributes) Configuration for the progressive release this plan runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release))
- `project_key` (String) The release plan's project key. A change in this field forces the destruction of the existing resource and the creation of a new one.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the release plan's purpose.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource in the format `project_key/environment_key/key`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this plan is the environment's default release plan. Manage the default in the LaunchDarkly UI; this resource only reads it.
- `release_method` (String) The release method the plan uses. Currently always `progressive_release`.
- `version` (Number) The release plan's version. Starts at 1 and increments on every update.

<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release`

Required:

- `phases` (Attributes List) An ordered list of phases the release progresses through. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--phases))
- `randomization_unit` (String) The context kind key used to bucket contexts for allocation.

Optional:

- `advancement_mode` (String) Whether a release started from this plan advances to the next phase automatically once the current phase's steps complete (`automatic`) or waits for a user or API action (`manual`). LaunchDarkly assigns a default when omitted.
- `cleanup_behavior` (String) What happens to the flag's targeting rules once a release started from this plan completes. `remove_rules_and_update_default_rule` removes the release's rules and updates the flag's default rule to serve the target variation; `leave_rules_in_place` leaves them untouched. Defaults to `remove_rules_and_update_default_rule`.
- `metrics` (Attributes Map) Metrics and metric groups to monitor during the rollout, keyed by metric or metric group key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--phases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.phases`

Required:

- `clauses` (Attributes List) Targeting clauses scoping this phase's audience. Must include the randomization unit clause (`attribute = "kind"`, `op = "in"`, `values = [<randomization_unit>]`), so the release only reaches contexts of that kind. To release to every context of the randomization unit, provide exactly that clause. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--clauses))
- `steps` (Attributes List) Ordered allocation increments within this phase. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--steps))

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of this phase.

<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--clauses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.phases.clauses`

Required:

- `attribute` (String) The user attribute to operate on
- `op` (String) The operator associated with the rule clause. Available options are `in`, `endsWith`, `startsWith`, `matches`, `contains`, `lessThan`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `before`, `after`, `segmentMatch`, `semVerEqual`, `semVerLessThan`, and `semVerGreaterThan`. Read LaunchDarkly's [Operators](https://launchdarkly.com/docs/sdk/concepts/flag-evaluation-rules#operators) documentation for more information.
- `values` (List of String) The list of values associated with the rule clause.

Optional:

- `context_kind` (String) The context kind associated with this rule clause. If omitted, defaults to `user`.
- `negate` (Boolean) Whether to negate the rule clause.
- `value_type` (String) The type for each of the clause's values. Available types are `boolean`, `string`, and `number`. If omitted, `value_type` defaults to `string`.


<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.phases.steps`

Required:

- `allocation` (Number) The traffic allocation for this step, in per-100,000 units. `100000` is 100% of traffic.
- `duration_millis` (Number) How long this step holds, in milliseconds, before the next step starts.



<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.metrics`

Required:

- `is_group` (Boolean) Whether the key identifies a metric group (`true`) or a single metric (`false`).

Optional:

- `auto_rollback` (Boolean) Whether to automatically roll back the release if this metric or metric group regresses. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An environment release plan can be imported using the project key, environment key
# and release plan key joined by slashes: project_key/environment_key/release_plan_key.
terraform import launchdarkly_environment_release_plan.checkout_rollout example-project/production/checkout-rollout
```
